caption:
Figure 1: Overview of MatGym. Across five simulated laboratories, agents explore candidates and
adapt tool use to feedback under resource budgets, then deliver a sample and its synthesis recipe.
Acceptance requires service performance, recipe–history consistency, and success on at least two of
three fresh batches. An earlier garnet task is shown. *Lab time excludes the simulated storage wait.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the complete final MatGym image and read the source caption and Sections 3.1-3.2 plus all eight independent source-pair checks. The preserved original includes five laboratory alternatives, all four exploration tools and feedback, the intact sample/recipe delivery, destructive sample distinction, all resource limits, and the >=2/3 replication requirement. The added top line correctly says the garnet example is illustrated rather than suggesting a sequential five-laboratory experiment. The bottom feedback-guided exploration statement is explicit in the source, and the storage-wait footnote matches the caption. The complete scientific source block is independently replayed; no result or value is fabricated.
